blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The country’s economic zone in Casiguran, Aurora, is seeking to attract Canadian investments in critical infrastructure, clean energy and defense manufacturing, capitalizing on opportunities under Ottawa’s P105-billion Indo-Pacific program. The Aurora Pacific Economic Zone and Freeport Authority (Apeco) is pitching these opportunities to Canadian businesses through investment roadshows in Montreal and Calgary this […]...
